<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 11:1">Ex. R. s. 11</cite> <he>אתם עשיתם ה׳ ה׳ וכ׳</he> you arranged troops against my children &c.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Cant. R. to VIII, 11</cite> (play on <cite ref="E00597"><he>המון</he></cite>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">ib.</cite> <he>באו עליהן המונות</he> (read: <he>המונים</he>) hordes came against them.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Ib.</cite> <he>שהמו אחריהם הֲמוֹנֵי מלאכים</he> (not <he>מלכים</he>) troops of angels rushed for them (to prevent them from receiving the Law, v. <cite ref="D00131"><he>דָּדָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Ib.</cite> <he>שהמו אחר המוני המוניות</he>, read: <he>שהמו אחריהם המוניות</he>, v. <cite ref="E00599"><he>הְמוֹנוּת</he></cite>.
